label: ElevenLabs TTS & Sound Effects
description: ElevenLabs API for text-to-speech and sound effect generation.

aspects.name: essentials
attributes: TTS: POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id} — returns audio bytes directly (no polling)
SFX: POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/sound-generation with {text, duration_seconds} — returns audio directly
Voice settings: stability (0.3-0.5), similarity_boost (0.7-0.9), style (0.5-0.7), use_speaker_boost: true
